verdict.rationale: Intercom documents an official, first-party MCP server that lets AI agents securely access and interact with Intercom data, and a probe confirmed the guide exists. Intercom also markets sharing conversation data with ChatGPT, Claude and Glean, so an agent can connect through an official MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: details on the exposed tools, auth and setup flow; evidence that the MCP server exposes Fin-specific actions (e.g. Ask Fin or running procedures) rather than general Intercom data; independent or hands-on corroboration.
